subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should automatic mode globally make any exhausted secondary or tertiary quota outrank a usable primary quota, and should Antigravity always prefer a 5-hour session quota when none is exhausted?
rationale: The branch changes cross-provider display policy rather than only repairing a mechanically defined contract; current behavior and prior review evidence support preserving generic primary lanes, but the intended product rule needs an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Use provider-specific exhausted priority
options.body: Keep generic providers on their supported primary lane and enable exhausted-first selection only for explicitly identified quota families with matching highest-usage behavior and tests.

options.title: Adopt global exhausted-first ranking
options.body: Accept the broader policy only after updating highest-usage exclusion semantics and adding provider-by-provider compatibility coverage for usable primary quotas.

recommendation.title: Use provider-specific exhausted priority
recommendation.body: Keep generic providers on their supported primary lane and enable exhausted-first selection only for explicitly identified quota families with matching highest-usage behavior and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-provider product-policy choice rather than a narrow implementation detail.
